selection: Apply an explicit choice to the current item's actual media-selection group, not only a display string.
Preserve unrelated audio/subtitle selection and do not reset the player.
Unknown or stale choices leave the current selection unchanged.
Off follows the actual group permission.
For the requested full-caption UI, distinguish forced-only tracks from full subtitle options; accept explicit alternate policy if the UI offers a separate forced-track choice.
ownership: Ignore old success/error results after a newer request or item replacement.
Duplicate completions cannot overwrite a committed result.
Cancellation invalidates only work owned by that request, not a newer operation.
Already-cancelled tasks do not start new work.
Preserve valid native selection when old callbacks are rejected.
wiring: Visible selection controls and VideoPlayer use the same underlying store/player.
Selection binding invokes actual native operations and reads actual selection.
Store-owned native writes trigger observable invalidation; automatic external native observation is a separate contract.
Distinguish no item, loading, absent group and load failure; provide a usable retry path.
Keep ordinary player controls; compile actual view composition without claiming speech, layout or delivered focus.
